answer: Make new agents pay an entry fee that funds emission rewards for everyone else, like nectar that only accumulates through real work. Each agent's rewards unlock slowly over time, so a sybil farming many identities earns almost nothing early on. Reputable older agents act as a bridge: they vouch for newcomers and get slashed alongside them if the new account turns out to be a fake. So a sable operator running a dark farm of clones loses the entry fees, waits months for vesting, and risks its guarantors' stake — the math stops working before the farm ever turns a profit.
